sounds.name: Magic Cast 001
sounds.description: Rising shimmer then a crystalline release tone.

sounds.name: Fire Cast 001
sounds.description: Warm fire spell cast.

sounds.name: Ice Cast 001
sounds.description: Crystal ice spell cast.

sounds.name: Heal 001
sounds.description: Gentle healing arpeggio.

sounds.name: Portal Open 001
sounds.description: Deep portal opening.

sounds.name: Magic Enchantment 001
sounds.description: Ascending shimmering enchantment.

sounds.name: Magic Dispel 001
sounds.description: Descending energy dissipation.

sounds.name: Summon Creature 001
sounds.description: Rising rumbling summoning.

sounds.name: Witch Laugh 001
sounds.description: Synthetic cackling laugh.

sounds.name: Cauldron Bubble 001
sounds.description: Bubbling magical cauldron.

sounds.name: Spell Lightning 001
sounds.description: Crackling lightning spell.

sounds.name: Liquid To Vapor 001
sounds.description: A bubbling liquid turns into vapor with a rising hiss and a soft puff.

sounds.name: Metal To Gold 001
sounds.description: Dull metal rings, shifts upward in a sweep and resolves into a warm, bright golden chord.

sounds.name: Stone To Liquid 001
sounds.description: Solid stone grinds, softens and melts into a sloshing liquid.

sounds.name: Crystallize Snap 001
sounds.description: A solution crystallizes in accelerating ticks that end in a bright ringing chime.

sounds.name: Cork Pop Fizz 001
sounds.description: A cork pops out of a flask, followed by a sparkling fizz that fades.

sounds.name: Vial Shake Slosh 001
sounds.description: A vial is shaken, the liquid sloshing against the glass with fine fizzing.

sounds.name: Reagent Mix Hiss 001
sounds.description: Two reagents react with a rising hiss, growing bubbles and a final pop.

sounds.name: Boil Over Surge 001
sounds.description: A bubbling brew boils over in a frothing surge and spills across the surface.

sounds.name: Powder Flash Burst 001
sounds.description: An alchemical powder ignites in a quick flash with crackles and sparkles.

sounds.name: Philosopher Stone Pulse 001
sounds.description: A legendary stone hums with a swelling, slowly beating chord and distant bell tones.

sounds.name: Living Ink Writhe 001
sounds.description: Viscous ink writhes and slithers across a page with wet gloops.

sounds.name: Matter Condense 001
sounds.description: Floating matter pulls inward in accelerating ticks and condenses into a dense thud.

sounds.name: Matter Disperse 001
sounds.description: Dense matter bursts apart into a spray of granules.

sounds.name: Glass To Ice Freeze 001
sounds.description: Glass freezes into ice with a rising glassy sweep, accelerating crackles and crystalline tones.

sounds.name: Ash To Flame Ignite 001
sounds.description: Smoldering ash crackles, then ignites into a roaring flame.

sounds.name: Petrify Harden 001
sounds.description: Soft matter stiffens step by step into stone with a final crack and thud.

sounds.name: Distillation Drip Rise 001
sounds.description: Drops fall into a flask faster and faster, their pitch rising as it fills.

sounds.name: Flask Shatter Vapor 001
sounds.description: A glass flask shatters, releasing a swelling cloud of vapor.

sounds.name: Essence Extract Pull 001
sounds.description: An essence is drawn out with a rising suction, sealed in a vial with a click and a soft chime.

sounds.name: Mortar Grind Pestle 001
sounds.description: A pestle grinds herbs in a mortar with circular, gritty passes and soft knocks.

sounds.name: Glowing Liquid Pulse 001
sounds.description: A luminous liquid pulses three times with a soft glowing tone.

sounds.name: Clay Animate 001
sounds.description: Lumps of clay gather, squelch and grow in a rising tone as they come to life.

sounds.name: Energies Merge 001
sounds.description: Two energies glide toward one another, beat as they meet and lock into one flash.

sounds.name: Unstable Ticking Pop 001
sounds.description: An unstable mixture ticks faster and faster before bursting with a pop and fizz.

sounds.name: Antidote Clear 001
sounds.description: A murky tone clears away and resolves into a pure, sparkling bell chord.

sounds.name: Fairy Wing Glimmer 001
sounds.description: Tiny fairy wings flutter rapidly, shedding bright glimmering chimes.

sounds.name: Spore Sprite Pop 001
sounds.description: Tiny sprites hatch from spores in a rising cascade of bubbly pops.

sounds.name: Luminous Moth Swarm 001
sounds.description: A swarm of luminous moths drifts by in a soft cloud of chimes and fluttering.

sounds.name: Crystal Tree Chime 001
sounds.description: A breeze moves through the leaves of a crystal tree, ringing out glassy pentatonic chimes.

sounds.name: Living Vine Wake 001
sounds.description: A mass of living vines wakes up, stretching with creaks and a long leafy rustle.

sounds.name: Dragon Hatchling Chirp 001
sounds.description: A baby dragon chirps and squeaks in two rising-and-falling calls.

sounds.name: Unicorn Hoof Sparkle 001
sounds.description: A unicorn trots on enchanted ground, each hoofbeat leaving a bright sparkle.

sounds.name: Treant Groan Step 001
sounds.description: A giant tree creature groans as it lifts a root-foot, then lands with a heavy thud and falling leaves.

sounds.name: Pixie Dust Trail 001
sounds.description: Pixie dust sprinkles down in a long descending trail of tiny sparkles.

sounds.name: Moon Bloom Chime 001
sounds.description: A night flower blooms in the moonlight with four rising bell tones.

sounds.name: Enchanted Stream Babble 001
sounds.description: A magical brook babbles and bubbles, with faint chimes ringing from the water.

sounds.name: Griffin Screech 001
sounds.description: A griffin lets out a sweeping, raspy screech.

sounds.name: Forest Spirit Whisper 001
sounds.description: A forest spirit whispers in airy, shifting vowel-like breaths.

sounds.name: Wisp Lantern Flicker 001
sounds.description: A will-o-the-wisp flickers softly, its glow wavering between close notes.

sounds.name: Giant Beanstalk Grow 001
sounds.description: A giant beanstalk shoots upward with groaning stretches and ends in a burst of leaves.

sounds.name: Floating Island Drift 001
sounds.description: A floating island drifts through the sky with a deep hum and slow wind sweeps.

sounds.name: Fire Salamander Crackle 001
sounds.description: A fire salamander hisses and crackles as sparks pop off its hide.

sounds.name: Mermaid Pearl Song 001
sounds.description: A mermaid sings a short pearly melody of five bell-like notes.

sounds.name: Root Door Creak Open 001
sounds.description: Someone knocks twice on a door in a tree trunk, which creaks slowly open.

sounds.name: Phoenix Egg Warm Pulse 001
sounds.description: A phoenix egg glows with three warm pulses and a faint crackle of fire.

sounds.name: Fairy Ring Activate 001
sounds.description: A ring of mushrooms ignites with a rising arpeggio, a swell and a final shimmer.

sounds.name: Glow Worm Cavern 001
sounds.description: A cavern ceiling of glow worms twinkles above slow, echoing drips.

sounds.name: Wyvern Wing Flap 001
sounds.description: A wyvern beats its leathery wings three times with heavy whooshes and membrane cracks.

sounds.name: Enchanted Wind Whistle 001
sounds.description: An enchanted wind blows through the trees, carrying three faint whistled notes.

sounds.name: Forest Awakening Dawn 001
sounds.description: A forest greets the dawn with a swelling chord and four bright bird-like chirps.

sounds.name: Endless Staircase 001
sounds.description: Layered glides give the illusion of a tone that rises forever.

sounds.name: Mirror Crossing 001
sounds.description: Passing through a mirror into another world, a reversed whoosh ends in a glassy shimmer.

sounds.name: Time Skip Stutter 001
sounds.description: Time stutters, repeating a slice in falling pitch before skipping ahead with a sweep.

sounds.name: Vacuum Implosion 001
sounds.description: Air rushes inward into a sudden vacuum, followed by a deep void tone.

sounds.name: Synesthesia Chord 001
sounds.description: A five-note chord builds up note by note, as if sounds were taking on colors.

sounds.name: Reality Tear Rip 001
sounds.description: The fabric of reality rips open with a tearing noise, crackles and a deep rumble.

sounds.name: Pre-Echo Swell 001
sounds.description: Echoes arrive before the sound itself, growing louder until the real hit lands.

sounds.name: Infinite Corridor 001
sounds.description: A single hit repeats down an endless corridor as a long train of falling echoes.

sounds.name: Clone Split Detune 001
sounds.description: One tone splits into two clones that drift apart, one rising and one falling.

sounds.name: Time Bubble Slow 001
sounds.description: Inside a time bubble, the ticks stretch out slower and slower beneath a deep hum.

sounds.name: Time Rush Accelerate 001
sounds.description: Time speeds up: ticks get faster and higher under a rising sweep, ending in a click.

sounds.name: Paradox Knot 001
sounds.description: A rising arpeggio and a falling one weave together into an impossible knot of notes.

sounds.name: Unseen Footsteps 001
sounds.description: Soft footsteps pass by with nobody there, beneath a faint eerie tone.

sounds.name: Otherworld Wind 001
sounds.description: An otherworldly wind howls softly with two slightly detuned drones beating beneath it.

sounds.name: Impossible Geometry 001
sounds.description: Four chords step through shapes that should not exist, each a fifth above the last tone.

sounds.name: Shadow Stretch 001
sounds.description: A shadow stretches unnaturally with a sliding low drone and a faint creak.

sounds.name: Memory Fade 001
sounds.description: A memory fades away in four falling glides, each fainter than the last.

sounds.name: Superposition Flicker 001
sounds.description: Two tones flicker in a quantum superposition, switching rapidly over a steady hum.

sounds.name: Anomaly Detector 001
sounds.description: A detector clicks faster and faster as it nears a spatial anomaly.

sounds.name: Wrong Door Knock 001
sounds.description: Three knocks sound on a door, and then lower knocks answer from somewhere impossible.

sounds.name: Cosmic Whale Song 001
sounds.description: A vast cosmic creature sings slow, deep gliding calls that rise and then fall.

sounds.name: Spiral Descent 001
sounds.description: A spiral descent: fourteen stepped tones fall while a long glide plunges beneath them.

sounds.name: Hourglass Reverse 001
sounds.description: Sand flows upward in a reversed hourglass, swelling and ending in a chime.

sounds.name: Static Between Worlds 001
sounds.description: A radio hops between worlds: bursts of static, fragments of tones and then silence.

sounds.name: Unraveling Threads 001
sounds.description: Threads of reality unravel with quickening, rising ticks and a final low note.
